title: MaleTheme Solo #001 · 남 클래식 머슬·블루 라인·서퍼 테마
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in the carved stone galleries of Angkor Wat with sunlit sandstone paving, standard-height doorways and low stone steps, empty of tourists, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as him, NO dark background NO black void, ONE person standing, sharp focus from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

SUBJECT: ONE real adult Chinese man in his early 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a fresh-faced boy-group idol face with clear glowing skin, bright eyes and a gentle smile line, clean-shaven, graphic electric-blue eyeliner extended into bold wings, smooth light skin with a warm golden undertone, a calm gentle gaze, deep burgundy wine-red hair styled in half-up, top section lifted with the length flowing loose below, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long rose-gold chain ending in one large faceted sapphire drop, and on the other ear a large silver hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on silver chains of different lengths (a silver cube-shaped block, an iron round bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and four to six layered rose-gold hair ornaments. Extremely long stiletto nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
SUBJECT Physique: An extraordinarily large and powerful, classically muscular man, far beyond any real person, in the shape of a Greek statue. Wide shoulders, a full defined chest, a clean six-pack abdomen, strong rounded arms, and muscular thighs and calves, balanced and proportionate from head to toe, powerful and enormous. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
SUBJECT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a shark-tooth necklace and a minimal neon-orange T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, soaked and clinging, water streaming down his whole body in glistening rivulets with countless droplets clinging to his skin, his hair soaking wet and slicked.
SUBJECT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on his hip.
SUBJECT Footwear: Extreme olive-green thick-soled derby shoes with thick platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary sole.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, the face toward the camera.
